name: numarasor.com

search.notes: Each number has its own page with user comments. Use the national format with a leading 0 and digits only, for example 05XXXXXXXXX.

steps: Open the Numara Kaldırma Talebi form.
Enter the number to remove, full name, email and a contact phone.
Choose the relationship Numara sahibiyim, or Yasal vekili if acting as a legal representative.
Write a short reason that cites KVKK Law No. 6698.
Submit and keep a screenshot. Answer if the site asks for a document proving the number belongs to the person.
optout.notes: Türkçe özet. numarasor.com'daki Numara Kaldırma Talebi formunu doldurarak numaranızın sayfasını KVKK kapsamında kaldırtabilirsiniz. The form says the site may ask for a supporting document. No time is stated. If nothing happens, use tr-kvkk-request.

verification_note: Removal form and KVKK notice loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21 and describe the removal request.
